steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow described by the case.
Enable eRFX-related event creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing can proceed.
Configure a price-based reverse auction awarded as an entire lot.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Select the first available auction pricing template so the product sheet is configured.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Set the first line item's delivery location.
Complete remaining required pricing-sheet values before publishing.
Invite three QA vendors for the Vendor A, B, and C audience described by the case.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Submit the first vendor's bid of 100 through the vendor portal.
Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Submit a second vendor's bid of 95 through a distinct vendor portal session.
Confirm the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Verify the buyer's Responses view shows both direct vendor responses.
Inspect the available invited vendor's supplier-portal view.
Open the auction pricing round in the vendor portal.
Verify the vendor portal exposes the current best price of 95.
Submit a subsequent bid below the current best price to exercise the available price-based bidding behavior.
Confirm the below-best-price bid was accepted.
